summary: Bottom-up n=7 numerator program. Mapped the full n=7 mixed-wall arrangement (42 walls, 3 S_3xS_4 orbits (1=1)/(1=2)/(1=3)), measured all single-wall LOCAL jump exponents EXACTLY with an n=6 control, found a PARITY CORRECTION (N_7 is EVEN, not odd -- 'odd' was an n=6-only artifact), and a correction to 'subset-sum walls carry exponent n-3' ((1=2)->2 != n-3 while (1=3)->4=n-3). Characterized the cross-term structure: the (1=2) observed order 2 is the (1=1)x(1=1) matching cross-term (1+1) whose forced locus is the (1=2) wall (s1_019 forcing geometry). Did NOT assemble the explicit N_7 (deg 22, ~hundreds-1000 coeffs) -- handed a complete wall/exponent/cross-term TABLE to student-2 for the all-n lift, as the PI's task split intends.

WALL MAP (n7lib.py, n7_walls.py): mixed subset-sum walls reduce mod complement to (1=1) a_i=b_j [12], (1=2) a_i=b_j+b_k [18], (1=3) a_i=b_j+b_k+b_l [12] = 42 distinct loci. (2=q) walls are the same loci by complement; same-type orderings analytic.

PARITY CORRECTION (s1_020): N_7 is EVEN under omega->-omega (verified exact A_7(-w)=A_7(w), N_7(-w)=N_7(w)). 'Odd' holds only at n=6 (minimal denom e3m+e3p degree-3 odd); at n=7 the minimal denom is the full 12-factor D_7, EVEN. So all n=7 coefficients have even total degree, and parity does NOT exclude a polynomial-in-squares object (unlike n=6/s2_015).

LOCAL JUMP EXPONENTS (s1_021, EXACT, clean sd=1 crossings, n=6 control passes (1=1)->1,(1=2)->3): n=7 gives (1=1)->1, (1=2)->2, (1=3)->4. CORRECTION to s1_019/s2_015: subset-sum walls NOT uniformly n-3 ((1=2)->2). Measured value = MIN over single-wall + active cross-terms.

CROSS-TERM STRUCTURE (s1_022, tentative): (1=2)->2 is the (1=1)x(1=1) matching cross-term (1+1). By s1_019 the (1=2) wall {a2=b4+b5} is forced by disjoint (1=1) edge pairs {a1=b6,a3=b7}/{a1=b7,a3=b6} (a1+a3=b6+b7); the n=6 matching cross-term lives ON the (1=2) wall -> jump order 1+1=2. n=6 (1=2)->3 is clean (matching forces a (1=1) there). Pure-exponent conjecture: (1=1)->1, all subset-sum->n-3; observed orders lowered by matching cross-terms. Evidence: forcing geometry + n=6 analogy + arithmetic + (1=3)->4=n-3 + 5-chamber correlation (all (1=2)->2 chambers have leftover (1=1) active).
